description: v2 of windah-gtavi-mandy (19 Nov 2026, user): hook title 'BENERIN PIPA NYA / MANDY??🔥🔥' (emoji as PNG overlay emoji-fire2.png, libass cannot draw colour emoji); everything else identical. Windah's reaction to the Mandy mission ('Pipe Work', chapter 1) in GTA VI (his own launch stream 45r3OyaxvFE, 18 Nov 2026). Source = stream-1944-2100.mp4 file 29:30-41:00 (source.mp4 local t = file t - 1770 s; local 0 = WIB 20:13:30; 690 s). New clean layout (19 Nov 2026): solid Ink #0E0F12, the whole 16:9 gameplay frame uncropped scaled to 1080x608 at y=656 (his facecam stays inside the game frame, bottom-right), no blur, no separate face panel. Hook = a short written title, not a quote, on screen from 0.00 s for the whole main clip: Audex 92, 2 lines max, bottom-anchored at (540,600), line 1 Paper 'MISI DI RUMAH', line 2 Volt 'MANDY'. Word captions Audex 72 Volt (Paper emphasis), Ink outline 7, shadow 3, one line, centred at (540,960). Credit line Audex 30 Mist at (540,1290) 'WINDAH BASUDARA · GTA VI' for the whole main clip. Watermark overlays the main clip only, then the 4 s outro, loudnorm two-pass -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP. Cuts (story in order; A 'Oh my God, Mandy cakep, misinya namanya Pipe Work ya'; B 'gua pernah nonton film... sorry gua pause ya... cewek yang suruh pipanya dibetulin sama tukang pipa' with the game paused; C 'lu kenapa pake bikini, kan lagi gak di pantai, gak di kolam renang'; D 'Mandy just came through... Mandy udah transfer duitnya'; E 'ga bisa dibuka, kayaknya dia ngumpet, dia BT sama kita, gue pengen minta maaf cuy, udah nyakitin perasaan dia'; F 'mending gua makan apelnya Mandy, enak nih gratisan apel'): A local 69.95-73.75 (WIB 20:14:39-20:14:43) -> output 0.00-3.80; B local 146.90-155.30 (WIB 20:15:56-20:16:05) -> output 3.80-12.20; C local 285.20-293.15 (WIB 20:18:15-20:18:23) -> output 12.20-20.15; D local 538.60-544.30 (WIB 20:22:28-20:22:34) -> output 20.15-25.85; E local 589.00-597.30 (WIB 20:23:19-20:23:27) -> output 25.85-34.15; F local 609.20-616.50 (WIB 20:23:39-20:23:46) -> output 34.15-41.45. Main 41.45 s + 4.0 s outro. Original audio kept (no mutes, user decision). Sensitive moments (kept unedited): B (output 3.8-12.2) the 'tukang pipa' innuendo; C (output 12.2-20.15) bikini line, Mandy in a bikini visible only ~1 s, mostly the pause menu. Caption text and timing carried over from the earlier Whisper-checked attempt. Source is input-seeked (-ss 65 -t 560), so trim times in filter_complex = local t - 65.
